description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'CacheConfig' that configures Infinispan cache managers for the OpenMRS project, including cluster and local cache setups, cache configurations loading, and JGroups transport settings.

classes.name: CacheConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up Infinispan cache managers with support for clustering, configuration loading, and JGroups transport.

methods.name: apiCacheManager
methods.description: Creates and configures the SpringEmbeddedCacheManager with either local or clustered Infinispan setup, loading additional cache configurations from YAML files.

methods.name: buildFullConfig
methods.description: Constructs a full cache configuration InputStream by merging YAML configuration files, applying cache type customizations.

methods.name: getCacheConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves cache YAML configuration resources from classpath.

methods.name: getJChannelConfig
methods.description: Selects default JGroups configuration file based on the specified cacheStack.
